boilerplate.text: Example Roasting Co. is a specialty coffee roaster in Asheville, North Carolina that roasts to order for home subscribers, cafes and offices.

Example Roasting Co. is a specialty coffee roaster in Asheville, North Carolina. Its main product is a home subscription: whole-bean or ground coffee, roasted the week it ships and delivered every one, two or four weeks. It has shipped more than 200,000 orders since 2016.

Example Roasting Co. is a specialty coffee roaster founded in 2016 and based in Asheville, North Carolina. It roasts every order the week it ships and buys from partner farms its head roaster visits each harvest. Home brewers subscribe to fresh whole-bean or ground coffee delivered every one, two or four weeks, and its wholesale program supplies 140 cafes with roasted-to-order beans, staff training and equipment advice. The company has shipped more than 200,000 orders since 2016 (as of 2026-10-27). It employs 38 people (as of 2026-10-01). Learn more at www.roasting.example.

press_bios.bio_short: Maya Torres is Co-founder and CEO of Example Roasting Co. Maya co-founded the company in 2016 after eight years as a cafe owner and leads strategy, retail and the subscription business. Maya speaks on subscription retail and running a direct-to-consumer food brand.
press_bios.bio_long: Maya Torres is Co-founder and CEO of Example Roasting Co. Maya co-founded the company in 2016 after eight years as a cafe owner and leads strategy, retail and the subscription business. Maya serves on the board of a regional small business association. Maya speaks to journalists about subscription retail, running a direct-to-consumer food brand and coffee prices. Interview requests go to press@roasting.example.

Daniel is a licensed coffee quality grader. Daniel speaks to journalists about direct trade sourcing, roasting and coffee quality. Interview requests go to press@roasting.example.
